decisions.evidence: The title incorrectly replaced absence of a full-rank standard embedding by non-diagonality. The integral lattice G=[[4,2],[2,5]]=B^tB for B=[[2,1],[0,2]] embeds with index4. Its norm (2x+y)^2+4y^2 has minimum4; an integral diagonalization would have two positive diagonal entries >=4 and product16, forcing both4, inconsistent with represented value5. Changed only the title and manifest title to name failure of full-rank standard embedding. The conditional statement and its full two-step proof were independently reviewed with actual gluing and Donaldson suppliers and are unchanged.
